transaction_adoption.observed_contract: The installed 0.0.48 PsycopgHost.adopt_transaction defaults to isolation=read_committed and compares the caller transaction profile against the requested (isolation, access_mode), returning invalid_transaction on mismatch.
transaction_adoption.r4_mismatch: The worker issued BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED, whose PostgreSQL default access mode is READ WRITE, then called adopt_transaction(access_mode="read_only"). The failure occurred before status/report/source/view methods ran.
transaction_adoption.recovery_profile: Begin the read-only reconciliation transaction explicitly with BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED, READ ONLY, apply the unchanged 2000 ms SET LOCAL statement_timeout, and adopt with access_mode="read_only". No isolation change or timeout increase is needed.

contract_findings.accepted_source_access: The public accepted_document person entrypoint checks caller membership in configured module_access reader/writer roles and checks EXECUTE on accepted_document. Complete catalog_view_in_transaction therefore uses a READ COMMITTED READ WRITE transaction while invoking only the public catalog_view method; no catalog mutation or direct table read is performed.
